rules.statement: Where a land is divided with the consent of all the co-owners but no cross conveyances are executed in respect of the lots, co-ownership terminates only after undisturbed, uninterrupted and exclusive possession of the divided lots for a period of over ten years.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a land is divided with the consent of all the co-owners but no cross conveyances are executed in respect of the lots, co-ownership terminates only after undisturbed, uninterrupted and exclusive possession of the divided lots for a period of over ten years. The 2nd and 3rd defendants who were allotted Lot A in Plan 2D5 on the amicable division in 1935 possessed it and gifted it to their daughter the 5D and her husband 6D in August 1957 on Deed 2D6.
